boundary_note: Source separates three theory problems and two experimental problems. Internal Task 1,2,3,4,5 and lettered parts remain inside their parent problem; the two experiments share apparatus but are explicitly separate top-level Experimental Problems 1 and 2.
rows: Conductor potential, supplied image-charge representation, electric force, electrostatic energy and small charged-pendulum oscillations
All tasks use electrostatics and small oscillations; the image representation is explicitly supplied and its proof is waived.
IPhO 2010 Theory Problem 1, all three physical pages read; charge/sphere, shielding point and pendulum diagrams visually inspected on pages 1-2. All four Tasks are one top-level problem.
Image-charge ansatz supplied; no external boundary-value theorem must be proved.
Hydrostatic pressure, given Bernoulli equation, ideal-gas density, continuity, heating and power efficiency
Chimney and solar-plant tasks use foundational fluid force/energy plus ideal gas and heat balance. Bernoulli is explicitly supplied.

IPhO 2010 Theory Problem 2, all four physical pages read; rendered page 1 checked because the entire Bernoulli formula was absent from text extraction; chimney and solar-collector diagrams visually inspected on pages 1 and 3.
Ideal-flow assumptions and Bernoulli relation explicitly supplied.
Given hard-nucleon packing/binding model, Coulomb energy, fission energy, reaction masses, momentum conservation and gamma recoil
Dominant content is nuclear binding/reactions and energy-momentum conservation under specified models. The final laboratory gamma Doppler extension is peripheral to the independently usable majority.

IPhO 2010 Theory Problem 3, all three physical pages read and visually inspected. Solution 319 pages 4 and 7-8 confirms a nonrelativistic reaction route and photon recoil; exact relativistic Doppler appears only in the final subsidiary lab-energy request.
Exact relativistic photon Doppler formula in the final subsidiary request is unsupplied and peripheral; no microscopic nuclear theory is required by the supplied packing/binding model.
Elastic energy, provided bending/stadium relations, force measurement, graph fitting and supplied rigidity-Young-modulus relation
Specialized sheet elasticity relations are provided; measuring and fitting force/compression needs ordinary energy, force and experimental reasoning.

IPhO 2010 Experimental Problem 1, all four physical pages read; rendered pages 1-3 inspected for stadium geometry, supplied energy/force equations and press apparatus. Internal numbered Tasks 1-3 remain one experiment.
Bending rigidity, stadium equilibrium and Young-modulus relation are supplied; no plate-elasticity derivation required.
Magnetic force polarity/symmetry, force measurement, equilibrium stability, graphing and gravity force balance
The task measures magnetic forces and interprets stability/symmetry; it explicitly avoids calculating a detailed magnetic-force model.

IPhO 2010 Experimental Problem 2, all four physical pages read; ring/rod magnet constraint and force-measurement apparatus visually inspected on pages 2-3. Shared press does not merge the two explicitly separate experiments.
